# Guara Slayer – Copilot instructions

Godot 4 2D action platformer (GDScript, placeholder shapes drawn in code). Scripts live in `scripts/`.

- Game design (premise, abilities, 10-boss roster, demo scope): see the `guara-game-design` skill in `.github/skills/`.
- When adding or changing bosses, update Yeral's on-hit hints in `scripts/yeral_hints.gd` following the `yeral-hints` skill.
- Follow the existing style: tabs, typed GDScript, `class_name` per script, bosses emit `defeated`/`health_changed`.
